annotations.title: Save stories for my next drive

description: Use this when someone wants Sal, WithBy's AI-generated narrator voice, to tell particular stories on their next drive: it adds 1 to 50 stories, by the ids the story, stretch and nearby-stories answers give, to their WithBy next-drive list, the same list as Save for my drive on withby.ai. Needs their WithBy account. Not for navigation, bookings or places outside Washington.

story_ids.description: The stories' ids, as the story, stretch and nearby-stories answers give them
